goal_text: Logic puzzle: Three speakers (Alice, Bob, Carol) each present once in Morning, Afternoon, or Evening on topics AI, Blockchain, or Climate (one each). Clues: (1) Alice speaks before Bob. (2) Climate is not in the Morning session. (3) Carol speaks in the Evening. (4) AI is presented in the Afternoon. (5) Bob does not speak in the Morning. Determine each speaker's session and topic.
ground_truth: Morning: Alice, Blockchain; Afternoon: Bob, AI; Evening: Carol, Climate. Carol Evening (3); Bob not Morning → Afternoon; Alice Morning (1); AI Afternoon (4) → Bob AI; Climate not Morning → Evening Carol Climate; Alice Morning Blockchain.
